unidades_propias
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.unidades_propias()
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT x.id), '{}'::bigint[]) FROM (
    SELECT u.id FROM public.accesos a
    JOIN public.unidades u ON u.condominio_id = a.condominio_id
     AND (u.propietario_id = a.propietario_id
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.unidad_propietarios up
                     WHERE up.unidad_id = u.id AND up.propietario_id = a.propietario_id AND up.fecha_fin IS NULL
                       AND (up.fecha_inicio IS NULL OR up.fecha_inicio <= now())))
    WHERE a.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND a.activo AND a.rol = 'Propietario'
    UNION
    SELECT ua.unidad_id FROM public.accesos a
    JOIN public.administradores ad ON ad.id = a.administrador_id AND ad.estado = 'Activo'
    JOIN public.unidad_administradores ua ON ua.administrador_id = a.administrador_id AND ua.fecha_fin IS NULL
      AND ua.fecha_inicio <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Santo_Domingo')::date
    WHERE a.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND a.activo AND a.rol = 'Administrador' AND private.aal2_ok()) x $function$

name: mis_inquilinos
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.mis_inquilinos()
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT a.inquilino_id), '{}'::bigint[]) FROM public.accesos a
  WHERE a.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND a.activo AND a.rol = 'Inquilino' $function$

name: unidades_inquilino
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.unidades_inquilino()
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT x.unidad_id), '{}'::bigint[]) FROM (
    SELECT i.unidad_id FROM public.accesos a JOIN public.inquilinos i ON i.id = a.inquilino_id
    WHERE a.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND a.activo AND a.rol = 'Inquilino' AND i.unidad_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT ui.unidad_id FROM public.accesos a JOIN public.unidad_inquilinos ui ON ui.inquilino_id = a.inquilino_id
    WHERE a.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND a.activo AND a.rol = 'Inquilino' AND ui.fecha_fin IS NULL AND ui.unidad_id IS NOT NULL) x $function$

name: puede_ver_unidad
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.puede_ver_unidad(p_unidad_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT private.es_ceo()
      OR p_unidad_id = ANY (private.unidades_propias())
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.unidades u
                  WHERE u.id = p_unidad_id
                    AND u.condominio_id = ANY (private.staff_condos('Facturacion','ver')))
$function$
